svg.aria-label: 6G4 · EYELET BOARD LAYOUT — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: Redrawn from Fender 'Super-Amp' Layout, Model 6G4 (A-FJ), page 2 of the two-page factory sheet (page 1 is the schematic) — not a trace

Heater layer: this drawing establishes its 5 V circuit against the amplifier's own sheet; the rest of the heater wiring it does not. At the centre-tapped valves (V1, V2, V3, V4, V5) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series arrangement; a 6.3 V supply straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. Which sockets
sit on the chain, and the order it reaches them in, are not affected.
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
blue — the output transformer's V7 plate lead, and the bias-tap lead the drawing letters blue-red
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
